documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported its Q4 and annual results for FY 2025-26, highlighting a highest ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT (112% of installed capacity) and an annual gross refining margin (GRM) of $9.2 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $5.83 per barrel. The company's board recommended a final dividend of INR54 per equity share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per equity share. Management discussed ongoing execution of key projects including Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS and retail outlets, alongside resilient operational performance despite global uncertainties and volatile crude prices. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited held its Q4 FY25 earnings conference call, reporting stellar physical and financial performance with a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT and a Q4 GRM of $6.22 per barrel. Management highlighted the ongoing upgrades, such as pharma-grade hexane and upcoming LOBS Group-II and III projects, alongside maintenance schedules and the Cauvery basin refinery expansion project.

guidance.claim: Management expects next year's maintenance CAPEX to be in the range of Rs. 200-250 crore.
guidance.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

guidance.claim: Without the LOBS project, normal maintenance and regular CAPEX is expected to be about Rs. 300 crores per year for the next two years.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

guidance.claim: With the LOBS project, total CAPEX is expected to be about Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crores per year for the next two years.
guidance.quote: And with this project, another Rs. 400 to Rs. 500 crores you can add for each of the year. So, without this project, about Rs. 300 crores per year. With this project, about Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crores per year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that MS in the southern market has a clear shortfall where production is less than demand by close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: The southern market's growth for MS is projected around 4%-5% and HSD at 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%. HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated that all approvals are in place for the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project, and project execution has started in full swing.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that the retail outlet endeavor has started, and commissioning will be seen during FY 2026-27.
capex_expansion.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

capex_expansion.claim: The management stated that the LOBS project is INR1,600 crores and the retail outlet project is INR400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the CBR project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The new refinery has a capacity of 9 million metric tons with a petrochemical intensity of 6% consisting of polypropylene.
capex_expansion.quote: The new refinery capital cost is Rs 36,000 Crore approximately, 9 million metric ton capacity and petrochemical intensity of 6% and which is PP, polypropylene.

margins_costs.claim: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the core GRM for Q4 was $10.3 per barrel.
The full year GRM for 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: On an overall annual basis, the inventory was a loss of $0.06 per barrel, or Rs. 40 crores.
margins_costs.quote: But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss came down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.
margins_costs.quote: I must place it that if you remember our Energy Indexes and our Fuel and Loss Indexes were quite high 2-3 years back and we went to a roadmap where we said on a sustained basis, we will bring it down to very efficient levels and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: Singapore GRM was reported at $4.02/bbl for 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, which is equivalent to 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: In quarter 4, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, representing 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The Manali Refinery has an installed capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.18 on a gross level compared to 0.39 last year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our leverage position now stands at 0.18. Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross borrowings are INR1,900 crores, while net borrowings stand at INR973 crores with a net debt ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, making the total dividend for the year INR62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt at an absolute level stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as of March 31, 2025, compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as of March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, representing 50% of the face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management mentioned that uncertainties due to logistical constraints and volatility of crude oil prices pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices pose a challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: International product cracks have reduced compared to the previous year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We all know that product cracks have reduced as compared to previous year in the international market, but our endeavor to better the benchmark continues.

risks_headwinds.claim: CST Under recovery was 246 crore for 9M 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the INR2,000 crores capex for LOBS and retail outlets will happen over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL is committed to developing new schemes on energy efficiency, bringing the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further down, and developing enhanced production of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: To summarize the physical performance, we are committed to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, take the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower and then develop enhanced production of value-added products as well going forward.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
